choose.when:
SELECT 'POLICY' AS type, p.policy_id AS id, p.policy_name AS name, i.name AS industryName FROM policies p LEFT JOIN industry i ON p.industry_id = i.industry_id WHERE p.policy_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.policy_summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LOAN' AS type, l.loan_id AS id, l.product_name AS name, i.name AS industryName FROM loans l LEFT JOIN industry i ON l.industry_id = i.industry_id WHERE l.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS type, NULL AS id, NULL AS name, NULL AS industryName WHERE 1 = 0

choose.when:
SELECT SUM(count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM policies WHERE policy_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR policy_summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
UNION ALL
